sidebar.name: YI 'DAVID' LI
sidebar.about: Hi, I’m David, a computer science student focused on building practical software. I primarily work with C++ and JavaScript and am developing a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming through coursework and projects. I’m continuously improving my skills by writing, testing, and refining real code.

summary: Full-stack developer skilled at seeing projects from conception to final product — collaborating across teams, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and collaborating others to deliver responsive, cross-platform web applications across 3 production applications.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio Website
bullets: Integrated a custom-prompted LLM chat-bot enabling visitors to interact with my background and projects in real time.
Developed and deployed a portfolio site with dark/light mode, mobile-first responsive design, and multi-page navigation using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

projects.name: CompanionCare – Pet Health & Community Web App
bullets: Shipped a full-stack pet care platform built with React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript, taking it from zero to production in 6 months and supporting 5 concurrent team members across a live user base.
Integrated AI-powered features, including an LLM-driven assistant that gives users personalized pet care guidance and recommendations.
Optimized REST API performance to maintain sub-200ms response times under live traffic.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-protected routes, securing 100% of user data endpoints.
Modeled Firebase Firestore data structures to support complex pet and user relationships across database design and API integration.

projects.name: ProjectClean – Full-Stack Issue Reporting Platform
bullets: Architected a full-stack reporting app using React.js and Node.js, with RESTful APIs, MongoDB persistence, and Cloudinary image uploads.
Launched an admin dashboard with real-time report tracking, improving workflow visibility and reducing manual follow-up.
Designed the full data flow end-to-end, giving student users real-time visibility into their submitted reports and staff administrators live status updates without needing a page refresh.

Proactively diagnose and resolved hardware, network, and EHR software issues (e.g., workstation failures, connectivity outages, software glitches) before they impacted patient operations, maintaining consistent daily uptime over 3+ years.
Administers and update electronic health records (EHR) in iClinic for 100+ active patient records, ensuring data accuracy and HIPAA compliance.
Train and onboarded staff on clinical software and equipment, coordinating patient intake and scheduling to support seamless daily operations.
Directed a 20+ member executive board to plan and execute campus-wide cultural events, growing average attendance from 40+ to 70+ students in a semester — a 75% increase.
Guided and onboarded 10 new members through structured resource-sharing and mentorship, accelerating their integration and strengthening board execution across all events.
